contract: A search_covers that fails SocketAuthority's pre-checks is answered with cover_search_error on the requesting socket alone. An unauthenticated socket gets {requestId (echoed when the payload carried one), error: 'Unauthorized'}; a request without a requestId or without a title gets {requestId as sent or absent, error: 'Invalid request parameters'}. No search starts, no provider is contacted, no result, complete, provider error or cancelled is emitted, and no other socket receives the event. A rejected CoverSearchManager.startSearch is also reported with cover_search_error, but v2.37.2 catches every search error inside startSearch.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the refusal pre-checks have no force or override mode.
The error text is not pinned: no client parses it (the web client logs data.error and shows a generic toast), so the scenarios assert a non-empty string and the echoed requestId.

The third emit site (server/SocketAuthority.js:424-429, a rejected CoverSearchManager.startSearch) is defensive and unreachable through the socket API in v2.37.2: startSearch catches every search error inside its own try/catch, so no scenario triggers it.

invariants.contract: A search_covers without a title emits exactly one cover_search_error to the requesting socket with {requestId, error} (requestId echoed, error non-empty), and none of cover_search_result, cover_search_complete or cover_search_provider_error. A search_covers from an unauthenticated socket emits cover_search_error to that socket and to no authenticated socket. When the payload has no requestId the event carries only error; an empty requestId is echoed as an empty string, and an empty but present title is rejected the same way as an absent one. Repeating an invalid request emits an error each time. An invalid request after a successful search emits only its own error and no result. Rejected requests contact no provider, add no row and leave a following valid search working.
